deadline.value: The Fall 2027 date is not posted yet. For Fall 2026 entry the international deadline was December 5, 2025 (domestic applicants had until February/April), so plan for early December 2026.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: No supervisor needed to apply; the department matches you with one after admission.
supervisor.quote: Is a supervisor identified before or after admission? MSc, PhD: After | Is a supervisor assigned by the graduate unit or secured by the applicant? MSc, PhD: Graduate unit

funding.value: All admitted students get full funding from research and teaching assistantships plus fellowships, with top-ups for scholarship holders.
funding.quote: Students are guaranteed full, competitive, graduate student funding through a combination of research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and fellowship support.

entry_route.value: Apply with a master's (A- average) or directly from a bachelor's into the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Direct entry option from bachelor's to PhD? PhD: Yes

english_waiver.value: The SGS summary says Chemistry requires IELTS/TOEFL from anyone coming from outside North America, so Indian applicants should plan to take a test (confirm with chem.grad@utoronto.ca).
english_waiver.quote: IELTS/TOEFL (required if coming from outside of N. America)

notes: Department website (chemistry.utoronto.ca) blocks automated access; details are from the SGS program page.
